rule.text: reason[out["value"].isna() | out["prev"].isna()] = "UNPRICED"

drivers.driver: the account value or the prior day's value is null because a holding on that day has no close: 1558543 account-days carry at least one unpriced holding-day (1556548 of the UNPRICED blanks match such an account-day; 1639 UNPRICED blanks have no unpriced holding-day on the same account-day, which is the prior-day half of the rule)
drivers.why: the driver is a missing close of the security; a vendor daily close of each unpriced security on its unpriced dates would supply it (the never-priced and gap securities); coverage by a vendor is not established, and the group with no ticker symbol may not be keyable by a vendor

rule.text: reason[(out["prev"] <= 0) if timing == "end" else (base <= 0)] = "NON_POSITIVE_BASE"

drivers.driver: the prior day's value is zero or negative, so the return has no positive base
drivers.why: a property of the account's own valued base, not a missing price; a vendor price does not change the base

rule.text: reason[first] = "FIRST_DAY"

drivers.driver: the first row of each account has no previous day in the table
drivers.why: there is no prior value to divide by; a price history does not create one

rule.text: #     DVR_CLOSE_STEP, for every account holding the security that day.

drivers.driver: a distribution day on which the security's close steps up by 0.5 to 1.5 times the per-share distribution, so the step cannot be separated from the market move (daily_returns sets the reason at line 263)
drivers.why: a rule of the method on the close and the account's distribution rows; the blank is by design, not a missing price

rule.text: HELD_REASON = "HELD_SOURCE_UNDER_REVIEW"  # --hold-cusips: every holding-day of a held CUSIP is blank with this reason

drivers.driver: a held security whose holding-days are blanked pending source review (988 account_day_value rows over 1 securities, the review list being the --hold-cusips or the Yahoo active-policy blank)
drivers.why: a held row under review: the blank is a source-review decision, not an absent history

rule.text: REGRESSED_UNDER_<after rule>: R28 for method_r28 over method_r26, AS_TRADED for the as-traded price basis over the store's), never valued.

drivers.driver: every daily row of an account-month that matched before the rule change and is a DIFF after it (ABSENT account-months)
drivers.why: a regression recorded by design of the rule separation; a price history does not change the verdict

rule.text: reason[out["n_unvalued"] > 0] = "FLOW_UNVALUED"

drivers.driver: an external-flow row whose Amount is zero or null and which the day's price cannot value (no price, or no Quantity or CUSIP)
drivers.why: the split between a missing price and a missing Quantity or CUSIP is not made in this census

rule.text: reasons.append("%d blank day(s) of %d; first blank reason: %s" % (len(blank), len(g), first))

drivers.driver: the month holds at least one blank day; the first blank reason of the month is DVR_CLOSE_STEP
drivers.why: the month's blank days carry this method reason, which a price history does not change

rule.text: reasons.append("%d blank day(s) of %d; first blank reason: %s" % (len(blank), len(g), first))

drivers.driver: the month holds at least one blank day; the first blank reason of the month is FIRST_DAY
drivers.why: the month's blank days carry this method reason, which a price history does not change

rule.text: reasons.append("%d blank day(s) of %d; first blank reason: %s" % (len(blank), len(g), first))

drivers.driver: the month holds at least one blank day; the first blank reason of the month is HELD_SOURCE_UNDER_REVIEW
drivers.why: the month's blank days carry this method reason, which a price history does not change

rule.text: reasons.append("%d blank day(s) of %d; first blank reason: %s" % (len(blank), len(g), first))

drivers.driver: the month holds at least one blank day; the first blank reason of the month is NON_POSITIVE_BASE
drivers.why: the month's blank days carry this method reason, which a price history does not change

rule.text: reasons.append("%d blank day(s) of %d; first blank reason: %s" % (len(blank), len(g), first))

drivers.driver: the month holds at least one blank day; the first blank reason of the month is UNPRICED
drivers.why: the month's blank days carry the UNPRICED reason; the fill is the same daily close as the UNPRICED days

rule.text: reasons.append("no daily returns for the month")

drivers.driver: the account-month has no daily_returns row at all
drivers.why: why an account-month has no daily rows is not split in this census

rule.text: reasons.append("no reported monthly return")

drivers.driver: the reported monthly figure is absent for the account-month
drivers.why: the reported side is the client's performance figure, not a price; a vendor price does not supply it

rule.text: reasons.append("reported value is null")

drivers.driver: the reported monthly figure is null
drivers.why: the reported side, not a price

rule.text: diff, verdict = None, UNGRADABLE

drivers.driver: guard: neither side is present
drivers.why: guard branch, see count

rule.text: return key, "reported span %s..%s is not one calendar month" % (start, end)

drivers.driver: the performance rows of the account-month span more than one calendar month or are not a calendar month; the reported figure is withheld
drivers.why: the reported side is withheld for a span reason; a price history does not change the span

rule.text: out[k] = (None, "%d reported rows disagree: %s" % (len(rows), sorted(map(str, vals))))

drivers.driver: conflicting duplicate performance rows for the account-month; the reported figure is withheld
drivers.why: a conflict on the reported side, not a price

rule.text: diff, verdict = None, UNGRADABLE

drivers.driver: reason texts not in the classes above (grouped by masked text in the run's counts)
drivers.why: grouped by masked text in the run output; not classified further here

rule.text: verdict = DIFF

drivers.driver: both sides exist and the compounded daily return differs from the reported figure beyond the tolerance
drivers.why: a computed value exists, so the month is not blank; a price history does not change the comparison

rule.text: ABSENT account-month  month_grades rows whose reason starts REGRESSED_UNDER_ (5 account-months): every daily_returns row of

drivers.driver: REGRESSED_UNDER_ reason on the month (a null verdict)
drivers.why: a regression recorded by design; the reason sits in the sidecar of the build

rule.text: verdict, reason = MATCH, ""

drivers.driver: computed and reported figures agree within tolerance; no blank day
drivers.why: not a blank; included for completeness

what_this_shows: Of 1584413 blank daily returns, 1584413 carry a reason (0 unreasoned), and of 78915 non-MATCH months 78915 carry a reason (0 unreasoned). UNPRICED drives 1558187 of 1584413 blank days (98.3%), 7492099 of the 15973399 unpriced holding-days belong to 3791 never-priced securities and 8481300 to 580 gap securities. A vendor daily close for the unpriced securities could fill the UNPRICED days (1558187 are a missing close), but it could not fill the 22521 NON_POSITIVE_BASE, 1533 FIRST_DAY, 1069 DVR_CLOSE_STEP, 988 HELD_SOURCE_UNDER_REVIEW and 110 REGRESSED_UNDER_AS_TRADED blanks, nor the DIFF months, and it has not been shown to cover any of the unpriced securities.
not_established: Bloomberg came-back per security: no committed record carries the per-security outcome of the request lists; BBG_ACTUALS.jsonl holds 5 job rows with cell counts only, so how many listed securities came back priced is not established.

Replay of the valuation's price resolution on the round-99 cache is not the served as-traded basis (the Yahoo substitution and the SECHIST store are not replayed): the replay priced 1720 cusips against 822 served priced cusips; the never-priced ticker-status split uses the replay, and its resolved-but-unpriced groups are approximate.
asset_type is read from the silver transactions Asset_Type column through the analysis module's universe reader (read-only); the round-99 transactions cache does not carry the column.
FLOW_UNVALUED split between missing price and missing Quantity or CUSIP is not made.
UNGRADABLE months with no_daily_returns: the reason the account-month has no daily rows is not split.
No blank day lacks a reason and no non-MATCH month lacks a reason on the served tables (unreasoned = 0 on both), so no row listing is needed.
